rationale: The prior plan was structurally sound but used an incorrect denominator in denial_rate_by_segment. Per the reflection and all three feedback items pointing to a wrong_denominator issue, revised to use adjudicated_claims as the denominator. This ensures denial rates are computed only over adjudicated claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted), which is statistically sound and necessary for correct segment-level comparisons. All other components remain unchanged as they were correctly specified.
changes_summary: Changed denial_rate_by_segment denominator parameter from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' to compute denial rates over only adjudicated claims per statistical discipline requirements.
